notes.title: SCP Strategy is available now!
notes.content:
[h2]SCP Strategy is now available on Steam![/h2]

We are so glad you are about to play the result of many months of development work, sleepless nights, and time spent in the Early Access. But this is not the end. Be aware that the game still will be getting updated with new content like new SCP objects, special events, and much more. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/b9e248c8ca88040aa44d3b3f7163f2ff7904a80f.png[/img]

SCP Strategy gives you an opportunity to manage your own SCP organization. You can catch SCPs, make research, improve your MTFs and your organization! 

Your mission is to make the world a safer place! You can focus on research on every single SCP or catch all of them and then start research. It is all your choice!

[previewyoutube=5CZbjZdEwxE;full][/previewyoutube]
Will your decisions rescue the world? We will see…

Good luck & have fun!
[b]LUXO Interactive team[/b]

notes.title: Devblog #3
notes.content:
[h1]Hi SCP players![/h1]
It's been a long time since the last devblog. SCP Strategy has been available in Early Access for 7 months. During this period of time, many things had been added and updated. In the next few weeks, we will publish [b]update 0.8[/b]. This update will add [b]CONTAINMENT BREACHES[/b]! You have been waiting for this feature for so long and finally, those events will come to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/66e265fec0f6a4cd2ffdd7014db22e1665cc2c75.jpg[/img]

That is the main view of your facilities. From this perspective, you will see a cross-section of your underground buildings. During containment breaches, you will see different sectors turning red. That means you are losing control of those cells. You will be able to use different procedures to regain control of them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/e2a38db889aadf949d3c639e9466c7508f26627f.gif[/img]

Psychologists say that well-decorated rooms have a positive effect on employee performance. Changing details in your interiors will affect your employees' statistics. That means choosing more decorated interiors will decrease the chance of containment breaches and increase the speed of conducting research.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/5e74878fe8d1c0d4368189017dc9f5757b10e980.jpg[/img]

We have added a new statistic on your main screen. That will show a chance for containment breach. Containing so many SCP objects in only a few facilities is dangerous and you should be prepared for the unexpected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/ebc71a21c00bff49c4c331ede9c1b47475e8644b.jpg[/img]

On a new skills tree, you will be able to unlock new containing procedures that affect your gameplay during containment breaches. We are still working on it so be aware of the possibility of changing it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/6a500c778c40d68aa27ac409d8d7d044ccb2f7d5.png[/img]

A few days ago we have asked you to fill out the questionnaires about SCP Strategy. We are so glad you had put effort into giving us a lot of feedback. We have read all of them and we will take them into account. Your opinions are so important to us.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/8888ec481b7e60d14949d9d399120333620ae253.png[/img]

One of the survey questions was about the game's price. Currently, the game cost 5$. We were planning to raise the price of SCP Strategy to 10$. This option won but so many of you chose [b]7$[/b].

We were discussing it for a while and decided to fix the price at a level of [b]7$[/b].

[b]If you want to buy the game at the current price, you can do so in the next few days. The price will change in the first days of April.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/3b47803496cbe31b42e3dcc56a2bca32055c8306.png[/img]

And finally, the most important thing for today. We want to announce the date of the full release of SCP Strategy.

[b]Mesdames et Messieurs, SCP Strategy will be released at:[h2]May 5, 2022[/h2][/b]
Does it mean SCP Strategy will lose support when version 1.0 will be released? [b]Absolutely not![/b]

In the next few days, we will update the roadmap so you will see our plans for future development.

We are so grateful you have been with us for so long and we hope the final release will be as much fun and entertaining as you want. We are going back to work so have a good day!

[h3]See you![/h3]
[h3]LUXO Interactive[/h3]

[h3]Other news:[/h3]
Update [b]0.8[/b] will add [b]50 new SCPs![/b]
We probably change the logo of SCP Strategy. 

If you have any ideas about how it should looks like let us know on our [url=https://discord.gg/xMAgCaat]DISCORD[/url].

notes.title: SCP STRATEGY - Update 0.6
notes.content:
[h1]Hi SCP players![/h1]

We are back with a new update! Do you want to know what is new?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/552c88ae9868cda38a3cee07cb36b91b05cf42ee.png[/img]

[h2]Anomalies Market![/h2]

Now you can trade objects. Unlock proper skills and the Anomalies Market will be available in the Scientific Department.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/d28f40c850e4508e29ab300a7ffc67c07d821129.jpg[/img]

[h2]Redesigned Scientific Department![/h2]

Now Scientific Department will let you sell your objects. The details section has been a little bit redesigned.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/53b8a3709ec0b3eff6df4e29e8a85ec8d3ab7f29.jpg[/img]

[h2]Improved Battles![/h2]

Now you can inflict critical damage to your enemies.  That makes battles more unpredictable. Moreover, after a few battles, you can completely destroy hostile organizations. Now, relationships between organizations will now be better simulated. That means their power will be changed every month.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/a05e0d5565ad17cb8bee5040fdae1db167fa3a56.jpg[/img]

[h2]New Skills![/h2]

Unlock new skills to increase the chances of your spies, get access to the Anomalies Market and inflict critical hits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/865c8ea5bb91aa3f6047cd2911bfb3dbdee8beb0.jpg[/img]

notes.title: SCP STRATEGY - Update 0.4
notes.content:
[h1]Hi SCP players![/h1]

We are back with a new update! Do you want to know what is new?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/552c88ae9868cda38a3cee07cb36b91b05cf42ee.png[/img]

[h2]The new Intelligence Agency screen![/h2]

Now you can find there other groups of interest. You can spy on them and then attack to gain some profits. This panel will also show you what organizations could be dangerous and learn more about their combat abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/e2abde53b950178b448f8ab4245b991355029eac.png[/img]

[h2]Organizations edtor![/h2]

Now you can create and share also new organizations. The new editor will let you the ability to create dreamed-up opponents.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/a4e81ae6d2f34f140b172027efa7ccd1c99add5a.jpg[/img]

[h2]Redesigned Internal Department![/h2]

Now Internal Department will let you manage all of your sites and MTFs easier in one place!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/1878877af821bed786698db65a00a16bfd9739da.png[/img]

[h2]Toggling borders![/h2]

Click the globe's icon on the top right corner to enable or disable borders. You can switch between three modes. The first one will show only coastlines,  the second one will show you countries' borders, and the last one will show you provinces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/57ca64c427d0780dd253f559a7fe5fcc80b36896.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Devblog #2
notes.content:
[h1]Hi SCP players![/h1]

We are so glad you are so active on Steam discussions and our discord. We really appreciate your feedback and we are working hard on improving SCP Strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/887265f8447fcdf412704bfedf1d978fca165ffd.jpg[/img]

Update 0.3 will be much bigger than we expected. When (a few months ago) we were planning incoming updates we were thinking about simple organizations system. We want to use your ideas and make SCP Strategy much better. That's why we have decided to create a casual turn-based battles system. Every turn will offer you the ability to use a few order points. Different actions will take different counts of order points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/7ad230e1bdbd02cd25f0eb565650b90576064355.gif[/img]

Unfortunately, we would not be able to provide this feature and other things planned to version 0.3. We want to publish updates regularly so we decided to rewrite this part of our roadmap. Do not worry! Earlier announced features will be added in version 0.4. As you can see [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1403020/discussions/0/3035976310916108103/]here[/url], the closest update will add the new battles system with a new skills tree. You will be able to unlock skills affecting your fighting capabilities. We hope that is a good compensation for your patience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/147a7b633538dfad283484e839e2c5e34960a671.gif[/img]

You are probably interested in how battles will look. When your MTF will find a site of Chaos Insurgency you will be able to attack it. In this case, you will control your MTF divided into smaller squads. You will be able to move your squad to be closer to the opponent's turrets and make aiming easier or play more defensive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/feebf14d1b3a6b7b631cdd384378c13218e8e9d2.gif[/img]

If you are attacked, the roles are reversed. Then you will be controlling static turrets and will be eliminating your enemies. You have to survive! If you would not, your facility will be destroyed and you lost some of your objects. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/543523918e21b4a4d79bb03b3b140ee16247e113.jpg[/img]

[b]This update will be released in the next few days.[/b] We want to thank you again for your engagement and we want to let you know that we will add [b]new 30 SCPs also in this update![/b]

Meanwhile, you can follow the game progress, ask questions and integrate with the SCP community on our [url=https://discord.gg/xMAgCaat]DISCORD[/url].

[h3]See you![/h3]
[h3]LUXO Interactive[/h3]

notes.title: SCP Strategy is available now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/2ddb365a143912ec95eb82a90ea4b8463f4d9dd5.jpg[/img]

[h2]SCP Strategy is now available on Steam![/h2]

SCP Strategy gives you an opportunity to manage your own SCP organization. You can catch SCPs, make researches, improve your MTFs and your organization! 

Your mission is to make the world a safer place! You can focus on researches on every single SCP or catch all of them and then start researches. It is all your choice!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/9b44bb349da3a9fda74bb1dad53084dfeea3636e.jpg[/img]

Will your decisions rescue the world? We will see…

notes.title: Devblog #1
notes.content:
[h1]Hi SCP players![/h1]


After our demo release, we get a lot of feedback from you! We are really happy that you enjoy our demo version and we are sure you will fall in love with the full version!

Since the demo version, we have changed a lot of things. The full game will be more balanced and you can spend more time playing it. We changed skills too, it looks so much better! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/a0ad36fbd7ba678fd4eef196532cd63dc833290d.png[/img]

We change the music style to something more mysterious than in the demo version. In a full game, the atmosphere is really exciting!

Because the community is the most important part of our project, we want to let you create the game with us! That’s why you will be able to use our object editor! There you can add your own SCP’s and it will appear in the game! You will be also able to share them in Steam Workshop.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/7cd029dde9caa14a1aed522ac2684cffca1add9f.png[/img]

In the full game, you can discover 100 SCPs! And we will be adding more and more new objects!

We just got approval from Valve and set a release date for [b]August 19[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40310365/02360fc8d624488ce2ef277d122d1f9b19114ce4.jpg[/img]

Meanwhile, you can follow the game progress, ask questions and integrate with the SCP community on our [url=https://discord.gg/xMAgCaat]DISCORD[/url].

We are waiting for you! 
[h2]See you on August 19.[/h2]
